title: Aspen Search team cards
description: A giant word and a two-line subheading on a hairline grid, a label, square arrow buttons and a paragraph, then 4:5 portrait cards with a mono role tag in the corner and a mint name bar with an arrow. On desktop four cards sit side by side over a halftone backdrop and each drifts up at its own speed as the page scrolls (scrubbed parallax); the arrows slide the row one card at a time. Phones stack the cards.
notes: needs JavaScript for the arrows; the parallax is a CSS view timeline (desktop only, off under reduced motion)
photo per card and the backdrop are media slots; empty, grey frames and a halftone placeholder
